questions.question: What did the eastern tribes (Reuben, Gad, Manasseh) build that alarmed the others?
options: A walled city near the border
A large altar by the Jordan
A temple to rival the tabernacle
A wall across the river crossing
questions.answer: A large altar by the Jordan

questions.question: Why had they really built the altar?
options: As a witness that they shared in the LORD, not for sacrifice
To rebel against Joshua and all the other tribes of Israel
To offer up their own sacrifices apart from the rest of Israel
To worship the idols of the surrounding pagan nations
questions.answer: As a witness that they shared in the LORD, not for sacrifice

questions.question: A civil war was avoided when the eastern tribes explained the altar was a witness.
The eastern tribes built the altar as a _____ between them and the rest of Israel.
At first the other tribes feared the altar meant the east had turned from the _____.
